content: Anabi Iliya ɣar yeɣzar n Krit

Iliya, zi Ticbi, zeg imeɛzab n Jilɛad, inna i Axab: “S tidett am iddar SIDI, AREBBI n Israil, wenni umi beddeɣ zzat i wudem nnes, mařa ad dd-yas nnda niɣ anẓar deg iseggʷusa-ya, ad yiři aya mɣir s wawař inu!”
Yusa-dd ɣares wawař n SIDI, inna:
“Uyur ssenni, arr s uzeǧif ɣar ccarq uca snuffar ixef nnec ɣar tiɣzart n Krit wenni iǧan ɣar ujemmaḍ n L’Urdun.
Ad imsar ad teswed zi teɣzart u Necc umureɣ i ibaɣřiwen, aqa ad cek dinni sseccen.”
Netta yuyur deg webrid uca igga ɛlaḥsab awař n SIDI. Netta yuyur ad izdeɣ ɣar teɣzart n Krit nni iǧan ɣar ujemmaḍ n L’Urdun.
Ibaɣřiwen iwyen as-dd aɣrum d weysum ɣar tuffut uřa d aɣrum d weysum ɣar tameddit u netta iswa zi teɣzart.
Iliya d tajjač n Ṣarfat
Awarni waṭṭas n wussan, imsar, aqa yuẓeɣ tiɣzart, maɣar war iwti ca wenẓar di temmurt.
Yusa as-dd wawař n SIDI, inna:
“Kkar, uyur ɣar Ṣarfat nni iǧan ɣar Ṣidun, zdeɣ dinni. Xzar, necc umureɣ dinni i yict n tajjač, maḥend ad cek tessecc.”
Netta ikkar, yuyur ɣar Ṣarfat. Umi dd-yusa ɣar tewwart n tendint, xzar, ict n tajjač tᵉttḥarwac akeccuḍ. Netta iřaɣa xas, inna: “Awi ayi-dd ca n waman deg uɣarraf-a, ḥima ad sweɣ.”
Umi tuyur nettat ḥima ad dd-tawi aya, iřaɣa-dd netta xas: “Awi ayi-dd uřa d ijj n uřeqqim n weɣrum deg ufus nnem.

Maca nettat tenna: “S tidett am iddar SIDI, AREBBI nnec, min ɣari d tafdiřt, aqa mɣir ict n wuru n waren deg ubuqař d ca n zzect deg uɣarraf! Xzar necc ḥarwceɣ tnayen n ikeccuḍen u ad t sswejdeɣ i necc d mmi, xenni ad t necc ad nemmet.”
Inna as Iliya: “War tteggʷed ca. Uyur, egg min tuɣa tennid, maca egg ayi-dd d amezwaru ict n tefḍiřt u awi tt-i-dd da ɣari. Awarni uya ad tessewjed ca i cem u i ixef nnem d mmim.
Maɣar ammu i iqqar SIDI, AREBBI n Israil: ‘Aren deg ubuqař war ixekkʷi u zzect deg uɣarraf war tneqqiṣ ař ass i di i ɣa iwc SIDI anẓar x wudem n temmurt.’”
Nettat tuyur uca tegga ɛlaḥṣab awař n Iliya. Ammu i icca nettat, uca uřa d nettat d taddart nnes, aṭṭas n wussan.
Aren deg ubuqař war ixekkʷi d zzect deg uɣarraf war tneqqiṣ ɛlaḥsab awař n SIDI i issiweř s uqemmum n Iliya.
Awarni man aya, imsar, aqa ihřec mmis n temɣart-a, mmis n llala n taddart. Řehřac nnes yarni aṭṭas ařami war ittari ɛad nnefs.
Nettat tenna i Iliya: “Min din jar ayi d cek, a cek, aryaz n AREBBI? Ma tusid-dd ɣari ḥima ad ayi tessɛeqřed x ddnub inu u ḥima ad tenɣed mmi?”
Netta yarra-dd xas: “Ewc ayi-dd mmim!” U netta iksi t zeg weḥsin nnes, yarbu t ɣar sennej ɣar wexxam n nnej mani tuɣa izdeɣ netta simant nnes, uca issars i-t x qama nnes.
Xenni iřaɣa ɣar SIDI, inna: “SIDI, AREBBI inu, ma teggid xenni ɛad tuɛeffna di tajjač-a i ɣar zeddɣeɣ necc am ubarrani, ařami tenɣid mmis?”
Netta isarreḥ ixef nnes třata n twařawin tiwa i uḥenjir u iřaɣa ɣar SIDI, inna: “SIDI, AREBBI inu, ejj ad ɣares dd-yeɛqeb řeɛmar n uḥenjir-a!”
SIDI isřa i tmijja n Iliya uca iɛqeb-dd řeɛmar n uḥenjir ɛawed ɣares ařami dd-idweř iddar.
Iliya iksi aḥenjir uca issehwa t zeg wexxam n nnej di taddart uca iwca as t i yemmas. Inna Iliya: “Xzar, mmim iddar!”
Tenna temɣart i Iliya: “Řexxu ssneɣ aqa cek d ijj n weryaz n AREBBI u aqa awař n SIDI deg uqemmum nnec d tidett.”
